item.title: Spanish Music and Movement — Tue Sep 15, 11:00 AM — Sonoma Valley Library
item.description:
This program is presented in Spanish. Spanish Music and Movement is a tour of culture, language, and fun! This presentation is not for sitting - your family will be active characters in these adventures, participating with colorful scarves, instruments, and animals as you move to the sound of language. Even if you are not fluent Spanish speakers, see the language come alive through the animated and energetic activities designed for children under 6 years and family.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.title: Kids and Family Bilingual Yoga — Tue Sep 15, 11:30 AM — Windsor Regional Library
item.description:
Join us for this fun yoga class designed for children ages 2-9 and their parent/caregiver. Classes are conducted in Spanish and English. Led by Sara Gagnon. Free! Pre-register online to receive a reminder email. Please bring your own yoga mat, if you have one available. Class mats are available on a first come, first served basis.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

Mikayla McVey is a songwriter from Oakland, CA. She is thrilled to bring her band back to the best sounding room in the greater Bay Area. item.title: The Social Contractors Rock Riverfront Cafe! — Fri Sep 18, 5:30 PM — Riverfront Cafe
item.description:
“….Get ready for the super-entertaining sounds of local band The Social Contractors. They totally rock, in all the right ways…” - Argus-Courier
Join us for a wonderful summer evening of live music by the river! The Social Contractors will be performing an upbeat blend of melodic original rock and their own spin classic covers you know and love from the 60s-90s (Beatles, Doors, Hendrix, Pink Floyd, Men At Work, Police, Steely Dan, U2, and more).
The Social Contractors lineup for this live performance features band founder and songwriter, Jason E Davies (lead vocals, lead/rhythm guitar), Travis Thayer (sax/keys/vocals), Rob Neidel (bass/vocals), and Chris Oatman (drums).
Whether you like melodic vocals, searing guitar and sax solos, intriguing lyrics, captivating songs, or just great dynamic and danceable rhythms, The Social Contractors won't disappoint.
In addition to great live music, River Front Cafe offers a delicious assortment of food and beverages to complement the event. Enjo

item.title: Jack London Park Partners Gala: Jack's 150th - A Big Wish — Sat Sep 19, 5:00 PM — Jack London State Historic Park
item.description:
Celebrate Jack London’s 150th birthday with an evening inspired by his bold spirit, big ideas, and enduring love of this land. Join friends for a jubilant night of food, wine, music, and joy at the Park where legacy meets celebration and the story continues to unfold. We’ll toast to Jack’s extraordinary life, reflect on the dream he left behind, and dance into what comes next. It’s a birthday. It’s a milestone. It’s a bold wish. • When: Saturday, September 19, 2026 from 5:00-9:00 • Where: Jack London State Historic Park – Eucalyptus Grove and Winery Ruins • What to expect: Delicious appetizers and dinner catered by Park Avenue, amazing wine from Lasseter Family Winery, beautiful views, live music, and a great time! All proceeds benefit Jack London Park Partners, a 501(c)3 non-profit organization.
Source: GoLocal Cooperative

item.title: Sonoma Sundays on the Plaza - Tyler Lauren — Sun Sep 20, 8:00 AM — Grinstead Amphitheater – Sonoma Plaza
item.description: This summer, Music in Place and the City of Sonoma invite you to soak up the sunshine, sip local wine, and dance to live music at the Sonoma Plaza Grinstead Amphitheater during Sonoma Sundays On the Plaza, a free concert series running June 7 through October 4, 2026. This week’s lineup features Tyler Lauren! Tyler Lauren is a singer-songwriter known for her combination vocals–inspired most by 1990s Rhythm and Blues and Golden Era Jazz vocalist influences– and writing/production styles which she credits to her training in musical theatre. item.title: Stick Men ft. Tony Levin, Markus Reuter, & Pat Mastelotto — Mon Sep 21, 8:00 PM — Mystic Theatre & Music Hall
item.description:
Stick Men is a powerhouse progressive rock trio featuring legendary musicians Tony Levin, Pat Mastelotto, and Markus Reuter. With a combined experience of over 100 million records sold worldwide, this supergroup brings unparalleled musicianship and innovation to every performance.
Tony Levin, renowned for his work with Peter Gabriel and King Crimson, is one of the most recorded bass players in music history. His mastery of the Chapman Stick, from which the band takes its name, allows him to cover both bass and guitar parts simultaneously.
Pat Mastelotto, drummer extraordinaire, is known for his tenure with King Crimson and chart- topping success with Mr. Mister. His unique setup combines acoustic drums with electronic elements, creating a rich tapestry of rhythms and textures.
